candidate.title: scATAC-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned scATAC-Seq schematic comprises two explicitly named alternatives: Cell index (the combinatorial cellular indexing implementation described by Cusanovich et al., 2015) and Microfluidics (the Fluidigm C1 implementation described by Buenrostro et al., 2015). The independent routes begin at their own Cell suspension labels and end in DNA libraries. The single-cell-to-nucleosome illustrations at the left explain the accessibility target; they are not additional sample-processing routes. The neighboring scAba-seq and scRC-Seq rows and the clipped chemistry panel on the right belong to other poster content. The page-64 catalogue heading/caption matches Cell index only; its discussion of Fast-ATAC and other literature does not add targets. The three drawn wells at each indexing stage are represented as upper/middle/lower local branches, not an experimental well count. Microfluidics depicts one representative cell path; independently prepared libraries from other cells enter the explicitly labeled final pooling interface. This is a library-architecture extraction, with sequencing interpretation stated on product states; sequencing and data analysis are not drawn as additional operations.
